name: last30days
description: Research what people actually said about any topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News and the web.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: last30days
examples: What are people saying about AI video tools in the last 30 days?
last30days what users want in react

methods.label: Free sources
methods.detail: Reddit, Hacker News, YouTube, GitHub, Polymarket and the web, with no account and no key. X comes from the X plugin.

setup.title: Install yt-dlp for YouTube
setup.detail: YouTube search and transcripts run through yt-dlp, a free open-source downloader. Use Install below, or install it yourself and connect again.

setup.title: Python 3.12 or newer
setup.detail: last30days runs a Python research engine. Your agent checks for a real Python 3.12+ the first time it runs (the Windows Store shortcut does not count) and, if none is found, tells you the one command to install it and waits for your yes.

setup.title: No browser cookies
setup.detail: last30days never reads your browser's cookies here. X posts come from the X plugin, which you connect on its own card.

assist.label: Finish setup with your agent
assist.prompt:
Finish setting up last30days for me.

Run the last30days setup tool (last30days_setup), not the skill's own setup wizard, and never read my browser cookies. If it says Python 3.12+ is missing, tell me the one install command it gives and wait for my yes before running it, then run setup again.

Then tell me, in plain words: which sources are working now, which are not covered and why, and what each optional key would add. Remind me that ScrapeCreators is a paid third-party service (10,000 free calls, then pay-as-you-go) and that I add its key on the last30days card, never in chat.

methods.label: Free sources and TikTok, Instagram
methods.detail: Adds a ScrapeCreators key: TikTok and Instagram, plus Reddit and YouTube backfill when the free path comes back thin.

setup.title: ScrapeCreators is a paid third-party API
setup.detail: It reads public posts from TikTok, Instagram and other platforms for you. New accounts get 10,000 free calls, then it is pay-as-you-go. A last30days run spends credits only on TikTok, Instagram and the Reddit or YouTube backfill.

setup.title: Copy your API key
setup.detail: Sign in, open your dashboard, and copy the API key into the field below. It stays on this machine.

setup.title: Install yt-dlp for YouTube
setup.detail: Every way in also needs yt-dlp. Use Install below if it is missing.

methods.label: Free sources and Bluesky
methods.detail: Adds Bluesky search with your handle and an app password.

setup.title: Create a Bluesky app password
setup.detail: In Bluesky, Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords, add one named Dimension. An app password can read and post but cannot change your account; you can revoke it any time.

setup.title: Install yt-dlp for YouTube
setup.detail: Every way in also needs yt-dlp. Use Install below if it is missing.

form.label: App password
form.help: The app password you just created, not your account password.

tools.name: last30days_setup
tools.description: Set up last30days and report which sources are live: Python 3.12+, yt-dlp, setup complete with browser cookies off, the ScrapeCreators and Bluesky keys connected on this card, and the runner command every engine run uses.
